title: Actual practice can diverge from the official manual
text: The notes describe comparing accumulated guidance with advice given in real interactions. That is useful for identifying outdated procedure and exceptions, but the observed advice still needs review before becoming a general rule. Recording more interactions also raises consent and access questions.
qualification: First-party account; does not justify recording all meetings or treating observed practice as approved policy.
